types.SM.IntervalComposition.prod_inner_near_w:
SM.IntervalComposition.prod_inner_near_weights.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} {R : Type u_1}
  [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (T : SM.RefiningCutSet π) (D : SM.TripleArray n R) :
  ∏ k, (π.refinementInner T k).nearFarWeight D 0 =
    ∏ r ∈ (π.refinementMarkIndices T)ᶜ, D ((↑T).toComposition.nearTriple r) * ⅟2

  [Invertible 2] (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (T : SM.RefiningCutSet π) (H : SM.TripleArray n R) :
  π.nearFarWeight 0 H = ∏ r ∈ π.refinementMarkIndices T, -H ((↑T).toComposition.farTriple r) * ⅟2
types.SM.IntervalComposition.nested_summand_tr:
SM.IntervalComposition.nested_summand_transport.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} {R : Type u_1}
  [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (T : SM.RefiningCutSet π) (D H : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (X : SM.IntervalArray n R) :
  π.nearFarWeight 0 H * ∏ k, (π.refinementInner T k).nearFarWeight D 0 * ∏ j, X ((π.refinementInner T k).part j) =
    ((∏ r ∈ π.refinementMarkIndices T, -H ((↑T).toComposition.farTriple r) * ⅟2) *
        ∏ r ∈ (π.refinementMarkIndices T)ᶜ, D ((↑T).toComposition.nearTriple r) * ⅟2) *
      ∏ j, X ((↑T).toComposition.part j)

types.SM.farout:
SM.farout.{u_1} (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  (∀ (D H : SM.TripleArray n R),
      (∃ Ψ,
          (∀ (Y : SM.IntervalArray n R),
              (SM.nearFarTransform D H fun I => (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (RingHom.id R) Y) (Ψ I)) = Y) ∧
            ∀ (X : SM.IntervalArray n R),
              (fun I => (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (RingHom.id R) (SM.nearFarTransform D H X)) (Ψ I)) = X) ∧
        SM.nearFarTransform D H = SM.farTransform H ∘ SM.nearTransform D) ∧
    (∀ (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n),
        (SM.nearFarTransform (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) fun I =>
              ↑(SM.openTreeSum P hP g I)) =
            SM.boundaryUnitArray ∧
          ↑(SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn) =
              SM.nearFarTransform (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) (-SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g)
                (fun I => ↑(SM.openTreeSum P hP g I)) (SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn) ∧
            ↑(SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn) =
              SM.farOnlyOutput (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) (SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn)) ∧
      (∀ (D₁ D₂ H : SM.TripleArray n R) (X₁ X₂ : SM.IntervalArray n R),
          SM.nearFarTransform D₁ H X₁ = SM.boundaryUnitArray →
            SM.nearFarTransform D₂ H X₂ = SM.boundaryUnitArray →
              SM.nearFarTransform D₁ (-H) X₁ = SM.nearFarTransform D₂ (-H) X₂) ∧
        (∀ (H : SM.TripleArray n R) (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n),
            (2 ≤ J.leaves → SM.farTransform H (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) J = 0) ∧
              (J.leaves = 1 → SM.farTransform H (SM.farOnlyCoordinates H) J = 1 ∧ SM.farOnlyOutput H J = 1)) ∧
          ∀ (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (g : ZMod n) (J : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (hJ : 2 ≤ J.leaves)
            (hP : SM.G1 (SM.restrictedWordTuple P g J)),
            SM.edge (SM.restrictedWordTuple P g J) 0 = SM.boundaryWord P g J.left - SM.boundaryWord P g J.right ∧
              SM.farOnlyOutput (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g) J =
                ↑(SM.treeCoefficient (SM.restrictedWordTuple P g J) hP 0 ⋯)
